content:
We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the Diels-Alder reaction (forward). We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id.

We have to search template catalog with criteria: bonds formed: C=C to C-C (two new sigma bonds) and bonds order changed: C=C to C-C (i.e., double bond to single). In Diels-Alder, two new sigma bonds formed, and two pi bonds become sigma, also new pi bonds formed in the ring (the cyclohexene). But the description: "order changes from C=C to C-C, and from C=C to C-C as well." So bonds order changed: two double bonds become single.

Thus we can search with bonds_order_changed: ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"]? Not sure format. Might be "C=C->C-C". But we can try generic search: functional_groups_formed maybe "ring". Not sure.

Simpler: we can try to search without criteria, get list, then check each with check_smiles_reaction_template_matching.

First, use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule_smiles = target, no filters, limit maybe 20.
